caption:
Your AI dashboard says it saved 40 hours a week. 👀

That sounds like money. It might not be.

An hour of freed time only becomes a dollar in two ways: it gets used on work that had real value, or it lets you skip a hire or a contractor renewal. 💡

Everything else is just slack. The team feels less rushed. No invoice gets smaller. 📊

Most ROI dashboards cannot tell the difference, because all they see is tickets and time, not your staffing plan.

So before you trust the number, ask one question: what did we actually do with the freed time. ✅

Save this for your next ROI review, and tag the person who owns that slide. 🤝
